messages.subject: errors because of unset variables
parts:
hi everyone,

i have a shiny app with several tabs and it throws some errors like:

Error in if (input$method == "XXX") { : argument is of length zero

since input$method is not defined until the tab with the conditional panel is opened.

Can i set standard values for these inputs? I used selected = "XXX" but this seems to be not evaluated until the tab with the conditional panel is opened.

Any advice would be great, thanks a lot!
Felix

messages.author: 4ff0cd0800ebb0b6
messages.subject: Re: errors because of unset variables
parts:
This is probably because your input is coming in as "" initially.  You can do two things to solve this.  

You can set default input values as NULL and then when a user input values, it will queue reactivity. Make sure you also have some sort of return(NULL) statement on any rendering as well if(is.null(input$method){return(NULL)}. 

Alternatively, you can wrap your if() statement above in another if() statement that says:
if(length(input$method > 0)){
  #rest of your in statement...

}

I haven't tried the length() idea, but I had a similar problem, which is that basically while the page was still rendering (hence before the "." value I'm using for not selected was present in the input$name an error would be generated.   Also often if the page is loaded I want to check if the input is (not)  "."  for some functions but doing == won't work before the initial rendering since the input doesn't exist yet. So I ended up with

!is.null(input$dataset) & !identical(input$dataset, emptymatch )

where emptymatch == "."

which seemed to do the trick. 

Elin
